,[FORCE_TERMS_FLAG]

,[LANG_C_ADDR1]

,[LANG_C_ADDR3]
,[LANG_C_CITY]

,[LANG_C_M_NAME]
,[LANG_ID]

,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LAST_UNSUCCESSFUL_LOGIN_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as LAST_UNSUCCESSFUL_LOGIN_TIME

,[LOC_ACC_IND]

,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([NO_OF_TXN_ATMPTS],' ',''),''),0)) as NO_OF_TXN_ATMPTS

,[OCCUPATION]
,[ONLINE_REG_PWD]
,[OOF_FLG]
,[P_BRANCH_ID]
,[P_DIV_ID]

,[RANGE_LIMIT_SCHEME]
,[RET_AUTH_MODE_PREC]
,[SALUTATION]
,[SCHEME_ID]
,[SESSION_ID]
,[SMS_ALERT]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([SMS_NO_OF_ATMPTS],' ',''),''),0)) as SMS_NO_OF_ATMPTS
,[SMS_PWD]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TOT_NUM_LOGIN],' ',''),''),0)) as TOT_NUM_LOGIN
,[TRAN_AUTH_SCHEME]
,[TRANSACTION_ALLOWED]
,[TXN_CERT_MATCH_REQD]
,convert(numeric(18,3),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TXN_LIMIT],' ',''),''),0)) as TXN_LIMIT
,[TXN_LMT_CURRENCY]
,[TXN_PWD]
,[TXN_PWD_ENABLED_FLG]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(TXN_PWD_EXP_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as TXN_PWD_EXP_DATE

,[USER_ALERT_REGISTRATION_FLAG]
,[USER_ENCRYPTION_KEY]
,[USER_TXN_TYPES]
,[USER_TYPE]
,[USR_INT_CD]
,[VIRTUAL_USER_FLG]
,[WF_RULE_SELECT_AUTH]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,[LAST6_ACCT_NUM]
,[LAST6_FREE_TEXT_2]
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[RIB_CORPORATEUSER_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_RIB_CORPORATEUSER] STG ON DELTA.CORP_USER = STG.CORP_USER AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID
WHERE H='D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_RIB_USERENROLMENT WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
[ACCT_CATEGORY]
,[ACCT_TYPE]
,STG.[ACID]
,[BACKEND_SYSTEM]
,STG.[BANK_ID]
,[BRANCH]
,[CR_FLG]
,STG.[CUST_ID]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DB_TS],' ',''),''),0)) as DB_TS
,STG.[DEL_FLG]
,[R_CRE_ID]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(R_CRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as R_CRE_TIME
,[R_MOD_ID]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(R_MOD_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as R_MOD_TIME
,[USER_DEFINED_FIELD_1]
,[USER_DEFINED_FIELD_2]
,[USER_DEFINED_FIELD_3]
,[LAST6_ACCT_NUM]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[RIB_USERENROLMENT_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_RIB_USERENROLMENT] STG ON DELTA.ACID = STG.ACID AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID AND DELTA.CUST_ID = STG.CUST_ID
Where H='D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
STG.[BANK_ID]
,[BAY_USER_ID]
,STG.[BRANCH_ID]
,STG.[CORP_USER]
,[CUST_BANK_ID]
,STG.[CUST_ID]
,[CUSTOMER_TYPE]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DB_TS],' ',''),''),0)) as DB_TS
,STG.[DEL_FLG]
,[GRP_ID]
,[R_CRE_ID]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(R_CRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as R_CRE_TIME
,[R_MOD_ID]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(R_MOD_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as R_MOD_TIME
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION] STG ON DELTA.CORP_USER = STG.CORP_USER AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID AND DELTA.CUST_ID = STG.CUST_ID  AND DELTA.BRANCH_ID = STG.BRANCH_ID
Where H='D'
